Received this in a GWP and I was excited to try. I havent tried an eye gel consistency before, only creams. This unfortunately caused red marks and burning under my eyes.
I been ysing this product for a week now mornibg snd night and my eyes are still puffy.

This eye gel has been perfect for me whenever my eyelids or under eyes are patchy and dry from medication or dehydration. I apply once or twice a day for a few days and it gives the hydration I need and adds life back to my lids. Had to repurchase.

For the price I paid I am incredibly happy with this product. It feels like a smooth gel almost like a primer but it absorbs quickly and makes my under eyes brighter, less puffy and just naturally pretty.

The eye gel was fine to use for the first like 2 to 4 days, but after that it started hurting to use. My under eye area is peeling and burns after using the gel, and a spot where I dabbed a tiny bit of excess on one of my eyelids is still red and irritated over a week later. Either this is only supposed to be used like once a week and the packaging needs to be updated to reflect that, or there might be something wrong with the formulation because I don't have sensitive skin, so a reaction like this is really unusual.

avis.titre: It's useless at least for me
avis.texte: Good molecules other stuff is really good but the Yerba Mate Wake Up Eye Gel isn't working for me and haven't seen a big change but it does wake me that's for sure.

Looked up the ingredients, and everything seemed to be safe for sensitive skin. When I tried this cream this morning, after washing my face, it only took a couple of minutes until I felt my eyes getting irritated. I looked in the mirror to see my entire under eye area was bright red and still puffy. I started carefully removing with water then applied my usual face moisturizer to my eye area. The burning and redness is starting to go away. I will not use this again and plan on returning it ASAP. I would not recommend anyone try this for the first time before bed, in case of allergic reactions. I would not recommend this to anyone with sensitive skin.

I was hooked when it i saw matcha / green tea in the ingredients. I have tried most products but this eye creme has delevered the fasted reults i have seen. My under eye bags are HEAVY i see the most difference when applied daily.

avis.titre: Close to Perfect for an Amazing Price
avis.texte: I have fair, sensitive, dry, mature skin. I received this cream as a Christmas gift, and I have been using it for over two months (I still have a lot of product left). The skin under my eyes is quite sensitive, but this cream has not caused any irritation at all. I apply it under my eyes and on my upper eyelids, and a little goes a long way. I appreciate this product's firming and moisturizing properties - I can see and feel a difference in my skin. Unfortunately, I have not noticed any difference in the discoloration under my eyes. Still, the benefits are great, and the price is amazing.
This is light and goes on smoothly. Feels great under my foundation. Well with using.

Honestly surprised with the results. Ive tried so many eye creams but this one actually helped with the puffiness of my eyes. I use it in the morning and apply it before going to bed around the eyelids as well. I've definitely notice it has been making a difference and will be adding to my regular restocks:)

avis.titre: This product is a steal. Great results.
avis.texte: I'm 57 and have sensitive, dry, aging (ugh) skin. I've also been suffering from lots of puffiness under my eyes. I picked this up on a whim and have been super impressed - after a few weeks of use, my eye bags are definitely diminished and the lines under my eyes are also not as noticeable. I use this alone in the day, and layer it under a rich eye cream at night.

avis.titre: Only Under-eye Cream that's Worked for me!!
avis.texte: No matter how expensive I have gone with previous under eye products, I have NEVER had one that can actually depuff as well as avoid irritating my eyes. I will never use another product!
It was really heavy and sticky. I think it might have clogged pores too. Didnt feel as hydrating as other creams/gels. Probably a good primer tho!

avis.titre: Convinced me I need eye gel daily
avis.texte: I'm 37 and the fine lines around my eyes have creeped up on me over the past couple years. I'm not one that's against looking my age or attempting to reverse aging, but the fine lines get in my way when applying makeup the way I want to. I absolutely love this eye gel, it feels so nice on the skin (without making your eyes feel tight or crepe-ish) and I've seen a noticeable difference in the depth and overall appearance of the fine lines. Never would have thought something this ridiculously affordable would work with well.
used this for 2 months ish and noticed no difference with puffyness of dark circles, it felt sticky when it dried. Do not reccomend

avis.titre: Dark Circle and Under Eye Bags Be Gone.
avis.texte: I have dark circles under my eyes and experience puffy bags as well. For years I've used a different brand of eye mask everyday under my eyes. They were my staple. I started using the Yerba Mate Wake Up Eye Gel and haven't looked back. My dark circles are no longer noticeable and no more bags under my eyes. This is after years of wearing those little white sticky eye patches under my eyes.

I have extremely sensitive skin overall, especially around my eyes. I am very grateful there is no fragrance with this product and I have no sensitivity issues. It's more of a gel, but not heavy or oily. I'm 63 and my skin responds to my everyday usage. I use a very small amount, about the size of just the tip of a pencil eraser, and I tap it around the lower part of my eye. I've read positive results about people keeping it in the fridge to help with puffiness which makes sense, but I haven't tried that yet. As is, I'm really pleased with the results.
I like this because it brightens th dark circles under my eyes and it also gets rid of bags and puffiness. It absorbs quickly and is really just a good product over all
This eye gel gives me instant brightness. Even when I'm feeling tired, I apply this and the look makes me feel better.

I've purchased this multiple times, and I love the non-greasy feeling gel. It looked great under makeup and absorbed quickly. They reformulated and added corn starch - which is a pretty common allergy. I purchased my 4th tube, and my eyes puffed up. After the swelling went down, I was left with a gnarly rash that took a while to go away. It had been great; there was no good reason to change the well-loved formula.
I really like this eye gel, especially on the days where I feel and look tired. It definitely helps me look more awake.
This really works and doesn't make my eyes water it is at a decent price

That being said it is moisturizing a little goes a long way didn't see results really and unfortunately I'm getting millia around my left eye which I haven't had in a while since using better products. Again for the price it's worth a try. I'll just have to give away like many other face products that don't work for me

This product has quickly become one of my favorite morning skincare steps. I love how refreshing it feels the moment I apply it! It instantly wakes me up and gives my under-eyes a cooling, revitalized boost. Within a few weeks of consistent use, I noticed a big difference: my eye bags have significantly reduced, puffiness is minimized, and my under-eyes look brighter and more hydrated. The lightweight gel texture absorbs quickly without feeling sticky, which makes it perfect to use under makeup. Concealer glides on smoother, and I don't have to worry about creasing or dryness. It's such a game-changer for mornings when I didn't get enough sleep but still want to look energized and refreshed. For anyone struggling with tired-looking eyes or under-eye puffiness, this product is a lifesaver—it really does what it promises!

I have had dark spots under my eyes for a good while now. So wearing make-up was part of my daily routine as putting on clothes for work. When we were all facing Covid was when I stopped wearing it due to the mask. The ties always left a mark that showed where the ties were placed. It made me focus even more on the dark circles that I was trying to hide under my makeup. So I decided to try the MoLECULES serum not feeling 100% that it would work but it actually does. Day by day the pigmentation of my skin is clearing up. My eyes are not as puffy and the darkness in my skin is clearing up as well. I'm finally feeling less embarrassed day by day as I have continued my freedom choice of a non-makeup wearing day. The visual changes have people noticing my skin tone more and more. At the tender age of 63. My pimple blemishes are lighter than before and other spots are gone all together.
This eye gel is feels amazing at morning and night! It is a great start and end to my day, and improves the look of my under eyes instantly!
I absolutely love this product! It is the first thing I use when I wake up in the morning, and sets me up for my day! I definitely recommend.
